system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Rapier

Granted power: Once/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates).

  • Any creature that breaks a contract made in the Paladin's presence suffers disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours.
  • On your first hit each round, offer terms to the creature: it makes a Will save or cannot attack you until your next turn.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Asmodeus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
